final_answer: The Rosetta Stone is a pivotal artifact that enabled the decipherment of Egyptian hieroglyphs, unlocking the language and culture of ancient Egypt. It features the same text in three scripts: Ancient Greek, Demotic, and hieroglyphs. Since Greek was already understood, scholars could cross-reference the scripts to decode hieroglyphs. Jean-François Champollion, a French linguist, used this method to recognize that hieroglyphs combined phonetic and symbolic elements, revolutionizing Egyptology. This breakthrough allowed access to millennia of Egyptian history, literature, and religious texts, transforming our understanding of the ancient world.
